# BSides.no

BSides.no is a small static directory for BSides events and chapters in Norway.

Primary pages:
- Norwegian: https://bsides.no/
- English: https://bsides.no/en/

Source repository:
- https://github.com/hackeriet/bsides.no

The site links to local BSides chapter and event pages for Oslo, Kristiansand,
Bergen, and Stavanger. Local event details are maintained by the local
organizers.

Automated freshness checks compare the repository content with selected local
chapter pages and BSides Global listings.
